articles.title: Beatrice Orchard, 88, Tailor
articles.deck: Friends remember Beatrice Orchard for the many years of service to Eastgate.
body: Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Eastgate.
Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Upper Commons Historical Society in his or her name.

Born in Eastgate in the years after the war, Beatrice Orchard spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Beatrice Orchard died in September at home on Quarry Court, at the age of 88.

articles.title: Letters: Carver Place Parking Is Out of Control
body: To the editor: Please keep the bus shelter in the budget. Many of us on Carver Place use it every week. To the editor: I have lived on Carver Place for 14 years, and I want to say what a difference the Hickory Ridge Recreation Center has made.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the June meeting.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Mariana Tanaka, Upper Commons
